issues.description: The template's Main.java includes commented example usages of Seal, Pig, and Goat constructors with two parameters (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the problem UML, description, and the solution implementation define Animal subclasses with a single-argument constructor (name). This constructor-parameter mismatch can confuse students about the correct constructor signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor usage in the template consistent with the UML and solution. Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")), or alternatively, revise the UML/problem statement to document and require two-argument constructors if extra attributes are intended.
